verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a search library and cloud service like Orama, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. On-prem deployment and local embedding models are adjacent privacy features, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
